mapper.insert: insert into tb_mail_send_history(login_id, email, type, auth_code, created_at) values (#{loginId}, #{email}, #{type}, #{authCode}, NOW())
mapper.update: update tb_mail_send_history set mail_success_yn = #{mailSuccessYn}, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, end_at = NOW() where seq = #{seq}
mapper.select: select expired_at from tb_mail_send_history where seq = #{seq}
